Stop early with traffic_route_cancel. No route, firewall, DNS, DHCP or service configuration is changed.

client.description: Private LAN IPv4 address to observe.

duration_seconds.description: Capture duration in seconds; defaults to 300 and is capped at 300. The pcap is hard-capped at 32 MiB (no ring overwrite); the MAC is re-checked during capture.

idempotency_key.description: Required retry key so reconnects cannot start duplicate capture sessions.

mac.description: Expected client MAC; capture fails closed if ARP identity does not match.

name: traffic_route_start

description: Read bounded state for a DIAG traffic-route observation run through the privileged broker.

run_id.description: Traffic-route run ID returned by traffic_route_start.

name: traffic_route_status

path.description: project with webos/install.py, e.g. /root/repos/free-my-tv

tv_ip.description: TV IPv4 address (Developer Mode on, key already unlocked once)

description: Read-only LG Developer Mode pairing status: key presence and safe permissions, pinned public SSH host fingerprint, optional private IPv4 TCP/9922 reachability. Does not read private key bytes, authenticate SSH, alter known_hosts or provision TV.

tv_ip.description: optional private IPv4 LG TV address for read-only TCP/9922 reachability, never SSH or key use

name: webos_pairing_status

stream.description: go2rtc stream the app shows, e.g. tapo_c230_pip_mjpeg

name: webos_test

description: Create a durable P7 workflow checkpoint from a policy-resolved named project profile plan, pinned by SHA-256. Duplicate starts with the same workflow identity and plan are safe; a changed plan is rejected. This does not execute any step.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable retry key for the same start request.

path.description: Allowed project path used to resolve the pinned plan.

name: workflow_checkpoint_start

description: Read one durable P7 workflow step checkpoint from the SQLite authority. A missing or invalid checkpoint fails closed; this read-only tool never claims or replays a step.

workflow_id.description: Validated durable workflow identity to inspect.

name: workflow_checkpoint_status

description: Read-only exact preview of an existing trusted ten-stage project profile pipeline: original ID, root, clean starting HEAD, ROADMAP digest, scope and profile fingerprint. Creates no mission, claim or job. Pass this unchanged as mission_start.workflow_plan to authorize native pipeline execution; workflow_start scope is also required.
name: workflow_plan

description: Reconcile HOLD using pinned plans and actual job receipts. UNKNOWN or missing exits cannot authorize replay. Recovery uses the profile rollback and finalizer.
name: workflow_resume

description: Claim an idle unleased Git worktree for a trusted ten-stage profile pipeline. Requires exact ROADMAP digest and phase scope. Background maintenance advances bounded jobs; transport retries never replay stages.
name: workflow_start

description: Read the durable profile pipeline, its pinned worktree, roadmap, scope, starting revision and current job. Missing receipts remain HOLD.
name: workflow_status
